motivation: Haggag proves a fractional upstream quantity can be observed only through integer outcomes. The first Resource Coach settlement replay falsifies a one-step quantizer as the sole missing mechanism, but integer endpoints may still bias fitting when treated as exact real targets.
epistemicBoundary: This hypothesis was selected after seeing the 341-row renderer replay. LOPO is diagnostic, not fresh prospective validation. Any promotion requires future frozen previews.

hiddenEndpointHypothesis.trainingLoss: squared distance of predicted continuous endpoint to the admissible interval; zero inside

invariants: Same event pool and exclusions as shape-models-20260924.json.
Same model equations and same declared free parameters as Mstar/Mstarstar.
No new age, tier, coach, stat, allocation, dose, or renderer parameters.
Fixed optimizer start from shape_models.START; held-out player is excluded from every fold fit.
Production src/ and profiles/ remain untouched.

comparison.primary: LOPO censored-loss Mstar versus LOPO exact-endpoint-SSE Mstar on the same held-out rows.

interpretationRules: If censored-loss improves LOPO MAE/inside materially, integer endpoint censoring is a useful identification correction, not proof of the game's exact renderer.
If it only improves in-sample or only widens apparent coverage, reject it as an identification improvement.
Even a positive LOPO result remains exploratory until scored on future preregistered player previews.
